turns.userMessage: You may use ONLY the parts remaining in your inventory — every placement is rejected once a part+color runs out (check remaining stock with inspect_build). From this inventory, build a DINOSAUR: a standing four-legged or two-legged dinosaur with a long neck or big head, a tail, and a recognizable silhouette from the side. It must be valid and stable. Use the silhouette tool to check the side view reads as a dinosaur.
